general_tolerance: UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: THIRD ANGLE PROJECTION; DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; 2-PLACE DIM. ±.020; 3-PLACE DIM. ±.010; ANGULAR DIM ±1°.

views.description: Longitudinal external elevation of the coaxial stepped adapter: left cylindrical shank, large central flange, and smaller right shank with circumferential groove and beveled end. Fine surface shading is illustrative, not section hatching.
views.centerline_notes: Horizontal longitudinal centerline establishes the common rotational axis. Groove station extension lines must not be mistaken for separate holes.

views.description: Undimensioned right end view under the stated third-angle projection. Outer circle is the flange; smaller concentric circles show the right shank and its beveled end. These are solid external features, not a bore.
views.centerline_notes: Crossed centerlines establish concentricity of all three visible circles. No dashed hidden-edge depiction is present.

dimensions.notes: Printed 3.50; general two-place tolerance.

dimensions.notes: Printed .500 is clear. Its groove-side extension is very close to the groove root/center lines. Confirm whether this locates the left root edge or the groove center before fixing the groove's axial position.

dimensions.applies_to: right-end bevel axial length
dimensions.notes: Axial distance between the start of the end bevel and the end face; general three-place tolerance.

dimensions.notes: Printed 1.000 DIA.; general three-place tolerance.

dimensions.applies_to: circumferential groove root diameter
dimensions.notes: Printed .656 DIA.; interpreted as the groove root diameter, not a hole and not an additional independently specified end-tip diameter.

dimensions.applies_to: right shank outside diameter
dimensions.notes: Explicit ±.001 overrides the general three-place tolerance.

dimensions.applies_to: right-end bevel angle to shaft axis
dimensions.notes: Value and tolerances are in degrees; the schema has no degree unit. General angular tolerance applies.

dimensions.applies_to: groove flank angles to shaft axis

dimensions.applies_to: groove central/root flat axial width
dimensions.notes: Printed '.062 CENT'. Interpreted as the central flat width between the sloping groove sides. The CENT qualifier and its relationship to the .500 locating line should be confirmed from the original drawing; do not silently assume .500 locates the width midpoint.

dimensions.applies_to: left shank to flange shoulder root radius
dimensions.notes: Printed .12 R.; circumferential fillet; general two-place tolerance.

dimensions.applies_to: left flange outside edge chamfer size
dimensions.notes: Linear component of '.03 x 45°'; general two-place tolerance. Leader points to the outer corner of the left flange face.

dimensions.applies_to: left flange outside edge chamfer angle
dimensions.notes: Angular component of '.03 x 45°'. Value and tolerances are degrees; schema lacks degree units.

dimensions.applies_to: nominal flange axial thickness
dimensions.notes: Derived, not printed: D001 - D002 - D003 = 3.50 - 1.62 - .875. No independent tolerance assigned; inherits the source dimension stack.

dimensions.applies_to: right flange shoulder station from left end
dimensions.notes: Derived, not printed: D001 - D003 = 3.50 - .875. Coordinate convention: left end x=0, shaft axis y=0.

dimensions.applies_to: groove radial depth
dimensions.notes: Derived, not printed: (D009 - D008)/2 = (.746 - .656)/2. No independent tolerance.

dimensions.applies_to: nominal right end face diameter after bevel
dimensions.notes: Derived, not printed: .746 - 2(.094)tan(30°). This is distinct from the .656 groove root diameter. No independent tolerance.

dimensions.applies_to: right-end bevel start station from left end
dimensions.notes: Derived, not printed: D001 - D005 = 3.50 - .094.

dimensions.applies_to: groove locating reference station to right end
dimensions.notes: Derived, not printed: D003 - D004 = .875 - .500. This closes the locating chain without assuming whether the reference station is the groove root edge or center.

features.description: Base solid cylindrical blank, diameter 1.75 and overall length 3.50, subsequently reduced at both ends. Final central flange nominal thickness is 1.005. Axis is horizontal in the front elevation.
Annular end reduction from the left face to the shoulder at 1.62, leaving the solid diameter-1.000 left shank. Leave shoulder-root fillet for the finishing feature.
Annular end reduction from the right face over .875, leaving the solid diameter-.746 right shank. Right flange shoulder is at nominal axial station 2.625 from the left end.

Subtractive 360-degree revolved circumferential groove on the right shank: root diameter .656, central flat interpreted as .062 wide, 30-degree typical flanks to the axis. Locate by the .500 dimension from the right flange shoulder only after resolving which groove reference line it terminates on.
Circumferential .12-radius root fillet joining the left diameter-1.000 shank to the flange's left face.
Circumferential .03 x 45-degree chamfer on the flange's left outer edge; do not apply indiscriminately to the other flange edges.
Right shank end bevel with .094 axial length and 30-degree angle to the shaft axis. Nominal resulting end-face diameter is approximately .637458.

symmetry.plane: Any longitudinal plane through the shaft axis
symmetry.description: Nominal machined geometry is axisymmetric. The identification stamp is excluded. There is no transverse mid-length mirror symmetry.

concentric_groups.description: Flange, both shanks, groove, root fillet, and edge bevels share the longitudinal axis, as corroborated by the end-view centerlines. No explicit concentricity GD&T is specified.

dimension_chains.description: Overall length = left shoulder station + flange thickness + right projection: 3.50 = 1.62 + 1.005 + .875.
Overall length = bevel start station + bevel axial length: 3.50 = 3.406 + .094.
Right projection = shoulder-to-groove reference station + station-to-end distance: .875 = .500 + .375.

warnings: No named ASME/ISO/DIN standard is printed. Third-angle projection and inch units are explicitly stated; a named standard has not been invented.

The .500 groove locating value is legible, but the tightly spaced extension lines and '.062 CENT' qualifier leave the exact groove locating convention uncertain. Confirm root-edge versus center referencing before releasing a model or manufacturing drawing.

The .656 diameter is interpreted as the groove root. The end bevel is separately controlled by .094 axial length and 30 degrees; these imply a nominal .637458 end-face diameter. Do not impose .656 on the end face as an additional constraint.
Angular dimensions and angular tolerances are degrees. Their unit field uses inch only because the supplied schema has no degree option.
Identification note: STAMP 'SB 12051', with leader to the flange outside surface. Letter size, stamp depth, and precise placement are not dimensioned; no invented engraved cut is included.
Material note specifies 4150 and R/C 40–45. No surface-finish roughness or coating specification is shown.
Title-block supplementary information: model number 220 B; date March 26, 1979; manufacturer Manufacturing Technology Inc.; sheet size B; sheet 1 of 1. Revision is not supplied.
No holes, threads, datum identifiers, feature-control frames, or reference dimensions are specified. Concentric end-view circles represent exterior stepped geometry.
Derived dimensions have no independent manufacturing tolerances; their variation follows the controlling dimensions, not the decimal-place rule applied afresh.
F004 uses the available revolve operation label for a subtractive revolved groove, not an additive boss.
